description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'NusoapSoap' that implements SOAP server functionality using the NuSOAP library for the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform. It handles construction of a SOAP server, registration of types and functions, and manages responses and errors related to SOAP requests.

classes.name: NusoapSoap
classes.description: Abstract class implementing SOAP server functionality for SuiteCRM using NuSOAP library, responsible for request handling, response, and fault management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP server with a specified URL, configuring WSDL and setting up the NuSOAP server instance.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Handles unexpected shutdowns by sending fault responses if the service stops unexpectedly.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Processes incoming SOAP requests and returns responses, managing PHP output buffers and logging.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Registers complex data types with the NuSOAP server for WSDL generation.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers service functions with the NuSOAP server, considering the 'use' and 'style' request parameters.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Associates an implementation class with the server so that SOAP calls invoke methods on that class.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Sets the registry class name for the SOAP server.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets a fault response on the SOAP server using an error object.
